title: Echo's of the Dark Escaped from Asylum Part 2
description:
After escaping the horrors of the asylum, the nightmare is far from over.

In Echo's of the Dark Part 2: Escaped from Asylum, you find yourself trapped within a dark and unforgiving forest where danger lurks behind every tree. As mysterious sounds echo through the night and entities stalk your every move, survival becomes your only objective. Just Survive.

Features• first-person horror experience

• atmospheric forest environments

•  jump scares

•  horror elements

• Exploration and story-driven gameplay

Can you escape the darkness, or will you become its next victim?
description_short: After uncovering the asylum's dark secrets in Part 1, you escape with the help of mysterious allies.
